summary.text: Ryan Williams is a Republican member of the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 42, where he has served since November 2010, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In the general election, Williams is on the ballot with Trenton Strode.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Williams earned a B.S. in biology from Carson-Newman College, where he had a soccer scholarship.
He has worked in construction and business development and previously served as a Planning Commissioner and City Council member in Cookeville.
Williams has represented District 42 since November 2, 2010.
In the 2023–2024 session he was assigned to the Commerce, Finance, Ways, and Means, Health, and Pensions and Insurance committees.
